title: EmbeddingConstraintStore L2-Normalization Fix
query_format_note: Queries are realistic SPO-style error context strings (5 variants per type). In the actual pipeline, the full response text is used as query. Single-word queries ('carry', 'sign') produce sims 0.37-0.53, often below threshold. Full-context queries produce sims 0.82-0.90, always above threshold.
root_cause: Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization deflected stored embeddings away from original semantic directions, causing near-zero cosine similarity between queries and matching stored constraints. Fix: store plain L2-normalized embeddings; normalize queries before retrieval; lower cosine threshold from 0.7 to 0.5.
